question: Are the successful cross-platform CI runs sufficient evidence to accept setup-node v7 in the tag-driven release workflow, or is a release-path validation required first?
rationale: The same action configuration succeeds in CI, but pull-request checks cannot fully execute the tag-driven publishing path.

options.title: Merge with release monitoring
options.body: Accept the successful CI evidence and monitor the next tag-driven release for setup-node or cache failures.

options.title: Validate the release path first
options.body: Run an appropriate non-publishing release-path validation using this exact head before merging the major action upgrade.

recommendation.title: Merge with release monitoring
recommendation.body: Accept the successful CI evidence and monitor the next tag-driven release for setup-node or cache failures.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available routing candidate for the affected CI and release workflows.
